Name: Olive Fruit Tree and Artisan Goods
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][color=#D4D4D8][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Adds new Olive Tree, artisan goods and cooking recipes made from oilves. Comes with new items, cooking and crafting recipes![/size][/font][/color]
[/center]
[center][color=#ffe599][size=3][font=sans-serif][i]Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/babystealth?gameId=3333]babystealth[/url] who commissioned me and encouraged me to share the mod on Nexus![/i][/font][/size][/color][/center]

[img]https://imgur.com/5nfFjjv.png[/img]

[size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b][u][color=#ffe599]New tree:[/color][/u][/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][color=#b6d7a8][font=Trebuchet MS]Olive Fruit Tree [/font][/color][font=Trebuchet MS]- sapling available for purchase at Pierre's for 6000g.[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Blooms in spring, bears Green Olives in summer and Black Olives in fall season.[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]In Greenhouse: always produce Green Olives only.[/font][/size]

[size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b][u][color=#ffe599]New Machine:[/color][/u][/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][color=#b6d7a8][font=Trebuchet MS]Olive Oil Press[/font][/color][font=Trebuchet MS] - gives new, more efficient way to produce oils. [/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Crafting recipe unlocks after reaching lvl 5 Farming skill.[/font][/size]
[size=3]Produces oil slightly faster and upgrades its quality based on the input item’s quality. For example, a silver-quality Truffle yields a gold-quality Truffle Oil.[/size]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Cornucopia oils are supported![/size][/font]

[size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b][u][color=#ffe599]New items:[/color][/u][/b][/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#b6d7a8]Green Olive[/color] and [color=#b6d7a8]Black Olive [/color]- used for making Olive Oil and in cooking recipes.[/font][/size]
[size=3]- Gift Tastes:[/size]
[spoiler]Universal like. 
Dislikes: Jas, Vincent.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Olive Oil[/size][/color][/font][/size]
[size=3]A highly profitable artisan good worth 1065g.
Priced the same as vanilla Truffle Oil, offering a viable alternative to pig farming.[/size]
[size=3]Can be produced in both vanilla Oil Maker and new Olive Oil Press.
Amount of Olives required to make Olive Oil can be tweaked in mod's config.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]- Gift Tastes:[/size]
[spoiler]Universal like. Loves: Caroline, Evelyn, Gus, Harvey, Jodi, Leah, Lewis, Linus, Olivia. 
Hates: Jas, Vincent, Krobus, Shane.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Olive Tapenade[/size][/color] [/font]
[size=3]New cooking recipe available at the Saloon for 1500g. Requires 1 Olive, 1 Anchovy, 1 Garlic, and 1 Olive Oil. Costly to make but provides strong buffs. 
Anchovy can be removed from the recipe via the config settings.[/size]
[size=3]   - Gift Tastes:[/size]
[spoiler]Universal like.Loves: Caroline, Evelyn, Gus, Lewis, Linus, Olivia.
Dislikes: Abigail, George, Haley, Sam.
Hates: Jas, Vincent, Leo, Shane, Krobus, Dwarf.[/spoiler]
[img]https://imgur.com/FfJ4Gp9.png[/img][/*]
[*][size=3][b][color=#93c47d]Compatible[/color] [/b]with expansions like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ [/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#93c47d][b]Compatible [/b][/color]with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][color=#93c47d]Compatible[/color] [/b]with  [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods[/url] (see Installation section for more info)[/size][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/K3YgnyS.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url][/size]﻿﻿[/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip "Olive Tree and Artisan Goods" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Enjoy![/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=3](Optional) If you want unique sprites for Pickled Olives: [/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install  [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url] (yes, it's github link, download it from there).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Download "[EBAGI ] Olive Tree and Artisan Goods" from Optional Files section and unzip archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size][/*]
[/list]

[url=https://postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t/config-options.png[/img][/url]
[*][size=3][b][color=#ffe599]Olives to Oil amount[/color][/b] - Defines how many Olives required in Olive Oil Press and vanilla Oil Maker machines. Set to 6 by default.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][color=#ffe599]More oils in Olive Oil Press[/color][/b] - Allows to produce other oils like Truffle Oil in the Press. Enabled by default.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][color=#ffe599]Vegan Tapenade Recipe[/color][/b] - Changes Olive Tapenade recipe so it doesn't require Anchovy. Disabled by default.[/size]
